title: 永劫続く追撃【エンドレスマイターン】

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm walking around the academy after class has let out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my… Yet another victory. You're good at this, Sei.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I can't believe this! I wanted to be the one to break your winning streak…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. Who's next?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Trainer. It's a card game we're playing. Sei is unbeatable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I've been mesmerized watching her blend mind games with her sound tactics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Want to try for yourself? There's time to kill before dinner anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get destroyed…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Rematch? I'm always up for more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me offer my support.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: While observing Sei's winning streak, I've learned a thing or two about her tendencies.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And from my experience in other games, I find that the presence of a supporter can often be the key to achieving victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Two on one? Sounds fun to me. Maybe that way you'll actually give me a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then let's have a fair contest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Try applying pressure with this card, Trainer. Depending on her reaction, we can infer—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure, sure. I already saw that coming. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike my first try, we put up a decent fight but come up just short in the end.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whew… You had me sweating for a second there. Not bad, guys, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, time's been killed, so I'm headed for din—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One more round, please.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's enough time for one more before dinner, yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Come, let's start the next match at once. You'll need to focus if you don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What luck, a good hand. Let's take full advantage of it and strike fear into her heart.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're playing that card now? Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. After all, you can't attack right now, can you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She's defenseless. Trigger a trap with that tactics card to keep her in place. Then, we launch an all-out assault.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer. Keep the cards coming. No hesitations.
choice_data_list: You're the best supporter I could ask for.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer. Keep the cards coming. No hesitations.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to hear you say so. I'll continue with my support, then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Our storybook ending is nigh. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… I should've let sleeping dogs lie…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We put our heads together and, after a hard-fought battle, come away with a win!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm a supporter, silly. Think of me as your tactician.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, the enemy is out of options. If we play our cards right, we can stay on the offensive all the way to victory.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Keep up the pressure. Pedal to the metal, go go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We ramp up the attack to eleven, securing a hard-fought victory!
